> **Webapp retired (2026-05-14).** These docs are served *while the Tauri dev shell is running*. Start it with `cd papercusp-desktop && npm run dev` — that boots embedded Postgres, the operator sidecar, and the Tauri webview together. Standalone `apps/operator` boots are no longer supported.

## What this is

A specification for **autonomous-harness frameworks** — systems that drive AI agents through a structured loop (plan → work → validate → done) against a project goal.

Papercusp specifies:

- **The harness contract** — what shape an autonomous-harness must have for plugins to extend it
- **The plugin model** — how third parties contribute roles, lifecycle hooks, UI, API routes, DB schemas, and routines
- **The capability system** — declarative permissions enforced at the DI boundary
- **The state model** — Postgres-backed, atomic-checkout, hard-stop budget enforcement, goal-traceable tasks
- **Two reference apps** — Papercup (organization layer) and the coding harness (sheets-clone, etc.)

## Status

Pre-1.0. Most foundational phases have shipped — including **Phase 6b** (UI render of plugin contributions plus the Backstage-style DI runtime, shipped 2026-04-29) — alongside the postgres schema, plugin SDK + loader, capability framework, substrate runtime, routine ticker, and server-side contribution surface.

See the [implementation status table](/internal/docs/implementation/status) for the canonical state.

## What Papercusp is NOT

- Not a hosted SaaS — it's a framework you self-host
- Not a replacement for Claude Code / Cursor / etc. — it composes with them, doesn't compete
- Not coupled to any specific LLM — uses whatever CLI you point it at
- Not opinionated about what kinds of harnesses exist — coding, org, research, marketing, all welcome

## How this doc is published

This is an [Astro Starlight](https://starlight.astro.build) site at `apps/operator-docs/src/content/docs/`. Running `npm run build` from `apps/operator-docs` compiles it to `dist/` with `base: '/internal/docs'`, emits per-page `.md` twins, then `scripts/postbuild-copy.sh` mirrors `dist/` into `apps/operator/public/internal/docs/`. The operator serves it statically at `/internal/docs` on its Hono host (`http://localhost:3070/internal/docs`) — reachable only while the Tauri dev shell is running. (It was previously a Fumadocs site; the emit-md-twins step preserves the old per-page `.md` HTTP surface.)

Access is **loopback-only**: the docs route returns HTTP 403 to any non-loopback host (only `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `::1` / `10.0.2.2` / `tauri.localhost` pass) unless `PAPERCUSP_INTERNAL_DOCS_BYPASS=1` is set. The Hono host also content-negotiates extensionless slugs: `/internal/docs/<slug>` returns the `.md` twin when the request sends `Accept: text/markdown`, and the `.html` page otherwise.

After v1.0 freeze, the canonical spec moves to its own repo.
